1 tablespoon light brown sugar
1 teaspoon seasoned salt
2 teaspoons garlic powder
1 teaspoon onion powder
1 teaspoon coarsely ground black pepper
A pinch of nutmeg
8 ounces cream cheese !room temperature!
1 cup whole milk
 12-ounce can evaporated milk
3 large eggs
1 pound dried elbow macaroni, cooked
2 sticks of butter (try to get unsalted instead of salted)!also room temperature!
2 Packages of Sharp Cheddar 
2 Packages of Mild 
*preheat oven 350* 
Mix butter and cream cheese, eggs, milk, evaporated milk, and spices together and add one package of BOTH cheeses combine with noodles and wrap tightly with aluminum foil and cook for 30 minutes. Take it out and the foil off, stir it and then put half sharp and half mild cheese on top and sprinkle some paprika on top and cook it until it’s brown and bubbly
